svg.title: Cat flap gate - mechanical variants
svg.desc: Four concept sheets share a dimensioned front, top and side-view baseline. Variant 1 has separate actuation, sensing, and support/linkage layers; the third sheet shows the PCB mount and component keep-outs; the fourth places sensors relative to the PCB.

g.aria-label: Top-down tunnel view, narrower than the frame, with 165 millimetre clear passage and continuation break
g.title: Top-down tunnel view with continuation break

g.aria-label: Gate plane centered within the front frame
g.title: Gate plane centered within the front frame

g.aria-label: Side section of frame and tunnel with continuation break
g.title: Side section of frame and tunnel with continuation break

g.aria-label: Gate plane seen from the side
g.title: Gate plane seen from the side
HS-0530B solenoids (left and right, side view)

g.aria-label: Guide bore, 6.6 millimetre bore with 4.4 millimetre top hole
g.title: Guide bore: constrains the latch to vertical travel

g.aria-label: Lock pins, 4 millimetre shaft with 6 millimetre piston, either side of the gate
g.title: Lock pins / latches (front and back of gate)

g.aria-label: Lock pin return springs, 0.4 by 5 by 20 millimetres
g.title: Return springs 0.4 x 5 x 20 mm (push lock pins up when unpowered)
Flap pivot rod Ø3 x 175 mm with knuckle

g.text: Components OK (both board faces, max 12.2 mm tall per side)
Keep-out: latch bores and springs (board passes between them with 0.4 mm per side)
PCB, 1.6 mm standard (0.8–1.0 mm leaves more wall around the bores)

g.title: PCB, 165 x 21 mm, spans the inner frame width

g.aria-label: PCB keep-out at the latch bores
g.title: Keep-out: no components, board passes between the two latch bores

g.text: outward ToF centres, mm from PCB left edge
piezo · hall · camera FFC centre (mm from PCB left edge)
inward ToF centres (mm from PCB left edge)
ToF centres, mm above PCB top edge
magnet Ø4 × 2 mm in flap bottom edge
≈ 5 mm to SOT-23 hall on PCB
VL53L0X ToF 13 × 18 mm, stacked in the top of each side rail: outward (purple) above, inward (teal) below; both aim 45° to the opening centre, tilted 30° out / in; dotted = viewing axis
Hall sensors, SOT-23 on the PCB top edge (front face solid, back face dashed); magnets in the flap above
SMD piezo buzzer 9 × 9 × 4 mm, front face, sound hole through the frame front
Camera (TBD) on the tunnel floor near the inside; 16 mm FFC along the floor to a PCB connector right of the latches; dashed purple = ToF wiring (≈ 220 mm outward, ≈ 190 mm inward)

g.title: VL53L0X ToF modules (outward above, inward below, top of each side rail)
SMD piezo buzzer 9 x 9 x 4 mm
Camera (TBD) on the tunnel floor, 16 mm FFC to the PCB
